title: Styrn command output envelope v1
description: Every finite non-interactive command emits exactly one document of this shape on stdout under --json. Normative source: docs/design.md Part 10.1-10.3. Diagnostics go to stderr and never appear here.

command.description: The canonical command path, e.g. "host status", "workflow run".

data.description: Command-specific payload; null on ordinary failure. Workflow and matrix outcome failures carry data.exit_code (10.4). Sizes are integer bytes, durations integer milliseconds (10.1).

allOf.$comment: Failures carry at least one error and normally a null payload. Workflow and matrix outcomes are the narrow Part 10.4 exception: they carry the wrapped exit code.

code.description: Dot-namespaced, stable, append-only within envelope v1 (10.3 registry; 2.8.5). Not enumerated here on purpose: the registry grows without a schema-version bump, while field removal requires one.

details.description: Structured context, e.g. {free_bytes, required_free_bytes} for resource.disk_admission_denied.
